title: What Consumer Centricity Means Today at the Estée Lauder Cos.
summary: Much has changed at the Estée Lauder Cos. in 80 years, but not the group's commitment to staying in tune with its consumers.

extraction.key_fact: 에스티 로더 그룹은 오랜 세월 동안 변화 속에서도 소비자와의 소통 및 이해를 지속적으로 중시하고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Much has changed at the Estée Lauder Cos. in 80 years, but not the group's commitment to staying in tune with its consumers.
